description: This file defines the EntityEcaSetField class, which manages setting and formatting fields within an entity configuration, including evaluation and formatting logic based on specified attributes.

classes.name: EntityEcaSetField
classes.description: Represents a field-setting entity within the ECA (Event-Condition-Action) framework, providing mechanisms to evaluate, format, and set entity field values based on XML configuration attributes.

methods.name: EntityEcaSetField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by extracting attributes from the provided XML Element.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates and sets the field value in the provided context map, applying formatting if necessary.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a string value based on the specified format attribute, supporting multiple formatting options including case conversion, hashing, numeric conversions, and name transformations.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field to be set.

methods.name: getRValue
methods.description: Returns the raw value or environment name associated with the field, formatted as a string if applicable.
